entities.name: Tours–Saint-Nazaire railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The railway from Tours to Saint-Nazaire is an important French 282-kilometre long railway line, following the lower course of the river Loire. It is used for passenger and freight traffic. The railway was opened in several stages between 1848 and 1857.
